glosses: meervoud van het zelfstandig naamwoord scheel

examples.text: Dat scheelt een slok op een borrel.

examples.text: „In den 50er Jahren des 18. Jh. beginnt die zeugende Kraft der barocken Kultur zu kümmern.“

glosses: To carry out an action, the result of which is a significant change, or an altered circumstance.

examples.text: I was hoping that, by volunteering at this refuge, I could make a difference, however small.

glosses: To be of importance; to matter.

examples.text: I don't think it makes a difference whether you come tonight or not.
